title: Pipe flow: continuity and Darcy-Weisbach head loss
description: Reusable SVG pipe-flow component that computes cross-sectional area, mean velocity, Reynolds number, friction factor, and Darcy-Weisbach head loss from explicit SI inputs.
learningObjectives: Relate discharge, area, and mean velocity using Q = AV.
Interpret Darcy-Weisbach head loss and friction-factor regime without confusing dissipative loss with elevation head.

verification.notes: Rebuilt as a host-scene Three.js educational component. Engineering model retained; rendered surveying-grade visual comparison remains pending independent browser review.
